WITH ranked_fact AS ( SELECT fact.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fact.member_jid ORDER BY fact.occurred_at DESC, CASE fact.status_source WHEN 'PARTICIPANT_LEAVE' THEN 4 WHEN 'PARTICIPANT_REMOVE' THEN 3 WHEN 'PARTICIPANT_ADD' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEMBER_SNAPSHOT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, fact.source_event_id DESC, fact.id DESC) AS state_rank FROM whatsapp_group_member_fact fact WHERE fact.group_jid = #{groupJid} AND fact.occurred_at <= #{statusUpdatedAt} ) SELECT current_member.id, ranked.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, ranked.group_jid AS groupJid, ranked.member_jid AS memberJid, ranked.participant_jid AS participantJid, ranked.phone, ranked.role, ranked.is_admin AS admin, ranked.is_owner AS owner, ranked.observer_account_id AS observerAccountId FROM ranked_fact ranked JOIN whatsapp_group_member current_member ON current_member.group_jid = ranked.group_jid AND current_member.member_jid = ranked.member_jid AND current_member.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ranked.state_rank = 1 AND ranked.membership_status = 1 AND ( ranked.occurred_at < #{statusUpdatedAt} OR (ranked.occurred_at = #{statusUpdatedAt} AND ranked.status_source = 'MEMBER_SNAPSHOT' AND ranked.source_event_id < #{sourceEventId}) )
AND ranked.member_jid NOT IN
#{memberJid}
